description: The Crimson Fledgling is a newly awakened vampire spawn, still learning the limits of its dark powers. Its eyes glow with a menacing crimson hue, and its fangs are sharp and eager for blood. It moves with an unnatural grace, blending into the shadows effortlessly. It prefers to prey on the weak but is extremely dangerous when cornered.
damage_resistances: Necrotic, Nonmagical Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing
languages: Understands Common and Infernal but doesn't speak

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: While in sunlight, the Crimson Fledgling has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: The Crimson Fledgling regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water.

actions.name: Claw Attack
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature, or a creature that is grappled by the fledgling. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. The target’s hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the Crimson Fledgling regains hit points equal to that amount.
